page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured with an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it provides 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, paired with 30 GB of system memory. Computational acceleration is delivered via a bundled NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Dedicated instance storage is provided by a 472 GB local SSD, and external connectivity is backed by a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct performance divergence between the host CPU subsystem and the dedicated graphics accelerator. Synthetic tests report low relative scores for general processing, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core metrics falling into lower percentiles and uncached memory write throughput measuring 13.47 GB/sec. Conversely, the onboard NVIDIA P100 accelerator demonstrates solid efficiency in deep learning execution, achieving top-tier prompt processing throughput of 9,863.53 tokens per second on 135M parameter models and 316.25 tokens per second on 7B models.

Given its hardware distribution, the instance presents an architectural tradeoff between older CPU architecture and dedicated GPU throughput. While sub-optimal for purely CPU-bound tasks, high-throughput caching, or database hosting, the inclusion of 16 GB GPU memory and local SSD storage makes this server a resource-efficient choice for small-to-medium LLM inference, legacy CUDA computing pipelines, and video transcoding.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated hardware acceleration alongside local storage. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, the configuration delivers 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores, 30 GB of system RAM, and a bundled 472 GB local SSD. Compute and tensor tasks are handled by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, supported by a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. While synthetic CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks show modest throughput characteristic of older host architectures, the P100 accelerator demonstrates competitive performance in machine learning inference, recording top-tier prompt processing metrics on small and medium language models. This instance offers a balanced environment for targeted AI inference, legacy GPU compute, and parallel graphics processing.
